name: PINOC
original_description:
PINOC turns text descriptions and videos into skeletal animations, generates rigged Gaussian splat characters, builds Gaussian splat 3D environments from a text description, and gives you access to a curated motion library.

Preview your characters and motions in the PINOC web app, or download them for your projects. Gaussian splat characters require a compatible renderer; see the renderer downloads and installation guides for current engine support.
